A1.justification: Both PDFs describe the same robustness study, with matching authors, methodology and core experiments. All pages, including equations, figures, tables and appendices, are readable and support comparison.

before.justification: v1 reports original fine-tuning experiments measuring adversarial and OOD robustness, including training trajectories, Pareto frontiers and numerical comparisons in Section 4.

after.justification: v2 retains those empirical results and adds ablation findings and Places365 experiments in Appendices A.3 and A.5.

M1.justification: The fine-tuning methods, PEFT decomposition and continuous robustness-evaluation framework remain unchanged. The new parameter sweeps test existing methods rather than introduce a new algorithm or component.

E1.justification: v2 adds Places365 scene-recognition experiments, using approximately 1.8 million samples, in Appendix A.5 and Figure 10. The original six downstream datasets, DomainNet domains and ImageNet-21k pre-training coverage are retained.

E2.justification: The corresponding original comparisons retain BitFit, Adapter, LoRA, Compacter, IA3, linear probing and full fine-tuning. The added Places365 plots use existing methods. CLAT is newly discussed as related work but is not evaluated as a comparator.

E3.justification: The original backbone, PGD settings, tracking schedules and hyperparameter tables remain unchanged. Appendix A.3 adds supplementary protocols: final-checkpoint sweeps of LoRA rank 1–20, Adapter reduction factor 4–32 and update location, plus four learning rates for LoRA's DomainNet trajectories.

E4.justification: Appendix A.3 introduces an ablation study absent from v1, examining parameter count, update location and learning-rate sensitivity. These substantially extend the analysis beyond comparisons among methods and datasets by directly testing possible explanations for the observed robustness differences.

E5.justification: Existing OOD ± summaries remain unchanged, and both versions contain shaded variability in plots. v2 adds error bars in Figure 9 but does not define their statistic, aggregation or run counts. It is unclear whether this changes uncertainty-reporting practice or simply displays variability for the added learning-rate sweep.

E6.justification: Table 2 and the original result plots retain their findings. New results report no consistent final-checkpoint robustness relationship with parameter count or updated layers, learning-rate effects that diminish toward convergence, and roughly 50% clean accuracy with very low adversarial accuracy on Places365. These are supplementary results, not matched-setting performance improvements.

T1.justification: Section 3.1 retains the same Gaussian-feature assumptions, linear fine-tuning classifier and derivation of the correlation bound in Equations 3–7. No mathematical definition, proof or theoretical correction is added.

C1.justification: The abstract, introduction and conclusion retain the same central claims: an adversarial robustness–accuracy trade-off during fine-tuning, task-dependent advantages of different strategies, and OOD robustness that tracks accuracy. The supplementary additions do not redefine these contributions.

C2.justification: v2 explains the runtime-driven restriction to PGD in Section 6. Appendix A.3 qualifies parameter count and updated layers as insufficient explanations by themselves, while A.5 acknowledges that weak Places365 performance prevents clear conclusions about robustness trends at larger scale.

D1.justification: Section 4.1 adds a source-code repository link and estimated costs of 2,100 GPU hours for adversarial evaluation and 3,780 for OOD evaluation. The new ablation ranges are documented, while existing hardware, library versions and hyperparameter tables are retained.

R1.justification: v2 adds CLAT and the Places dataset reference. Section 5 distinguishes CLAT's layer-level adversarial-training focus from this study's method-level robustness tracking. Adapter-Mixup refers to the already cited Nguyen and Le work, rather than a newly introduced comparison.

P1.justification: v2 makes localized wording and grammar edits, renames Experimental Setup to Experimental Design, expands Discussion into Discussion & Limitations, and moves future-work material there. It also adds acknowledgements and inserts appendix sections while retaining the main narrative structure.

P2.justification: Figure 2 is rearranged and adds full fine-tuning, linear probing and an information-intensity axis; Figure 4 revises its filtering illustration. Figures 9 and 10 add learning-rate and Places365 displays. Existing result plots and table structures are otherwise retained, with some relocation and spacing changes.

improvement.justification: The new sensitivity checks, explicit discussion of inconclusive Places365 results, and code-access and compute disclosures improve evidential transparency and clarify applicability. The gain is limited: parameter/location ablations receive only qualitative summaries, Figure 9's error bars are undefined, and the added large-scale experiment does not establish clear robustness trends. The core theory and main results remain unchanged.
